text:
# bko-holt load plan for layout.json
# Source: host-1, Fedora Linux 44 (Server Edition), UEFI boot with grub, dumped 2026-11-08T02:57:05Z
#
# Disks:
#   vda (16 GiB) -> /dev/sdq
#   vdb (16 GiB) -> /dev/sdr
#
# Notes:
#   - UEFI GRUB 2 through shim (Fedora, Rocky, openSUSE): the ESP's shim and GRUB are the restored ones; only grub.cfg is remade

# ---- partition ----
# vda -> /dev/sdq: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vda1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=4194304 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=4196352 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=5423104 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda3: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=5425152 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=33550336 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: gpt
label-id: bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512
table-length: 128
first-lba: 34
last-lba: 33554398

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=4194304, type=A19D880F-05FC-4D3B-A006-743F0F84911E, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
/dev/sdq2 : start=4196352, size=1228800, type=A19D880F-05FC-4D3B-A006-743F0F84911E, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005
/dev/sdq3 : start=5425152, size=28127232, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008
EOF
# vdb -> /dev/sdr: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdr
# /dev/sdr: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdr) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdr, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vdb1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=4194304 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vdb2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=4196352 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=5423104 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vdb3: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=5425152 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=33550336 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdr before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdr <<'EOF'
label: gpt
label-id: bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512
table-length: 128
first-lba: 34
last-lba: 33554398

/dev/sdr1 : start=2048, size=4194304, type=A19D880F-05FC-4D3B-A006-743F0F84911E, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000C
/dev/sdr2 : start=4196352, size=1228800, type=A19D880F-05FC-4D3B-A006-743F0F84911E, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000E
/dev/sdr3 : start=5425152, size=28127232, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010
EOF
udevadm settle

# ---- assemble ----
# md array md126 (raid1)
mdadm --create /dev/md/label1 --run --assume-clean --metadata=1.0 --level=raid1 --raid-devices=2 --uuid=bc000000:00004000:80000000:00000006 --homehost=localhost.localdomain --name=label1 --bitmap=internal /dev/sdq2 /dev/sdr2
# md array md127 (raid1)
mdadm --create /dev/md/boot --run --assume-clean --metadata=1.2 --level=raid1 --raid-devices=2 --uuid=bc000000:00004000:80000000:00000003 --homehost=localhost.localdomain --name=boot --data-offset=3072K --bitmap=internal /dev/sdq1 /dev/sdr1

# ---- format ----
# vda3: btrfs "fedora"
mkfs.btrfs -f -O extref,skinny-metadata,no-holes,^raid56,^raid1c34,^zoned,^squota,free-space-tree,block-group-tree -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009 -L fedora --csum crc32c -n 16384 -s 4096 -d raid1 -m raid1 /dev/sdq3 /dev/sdr3
# check: /dev/sdq3 is btrfs with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009
# btrfs bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009: its subvolumes
mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5 /dev/sdq3 /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009/home
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009/root
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009/root/var/lib
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009/root/var/lib/portables
umount /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009
# md126: vfat
mkfs.fat -F 32 -i BC000001 -S 512 -s 8 -f 2 -R 32 -h 0 -M 0xf8 /dev/md/label1
# check: /dev/md/label1 is vfat with the source's FAT size, sector and cluster size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# md127: xfs
mkfs.xfs -f -m crc=1,finobt=1,rmapbt=1,reflink=1,inobtcount=1,bigtime=1,uuid=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012,metadir=0 -i sparse=1,nrext64=1,size=512,exchange=1,maxpct=25 -n ftype=1,size=4096,parent=1 -b size=4096 -s size=512 -d size=2144337920,agsize=536084480 -l lazy-count=1,size=67108864 /dev/md/boot
# check: /dev/md/boot is xfs with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)

# ---- mount ----
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=root,compress=zstd:1 /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/boot
mount -t xfs -o defaults /dev/md/boot /mnt/bko-target/boot
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/home
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=home,compress=zstd:1 /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/home
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/boot/efi
mount -t vfat -o umask=0077,shortname=winnt /dev/md/label1 /mnt/bko-target/boot/efi

# ---- restore ----
# snapshot latest of /srv/bko-repo, with BackOtter's restore flags
RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id latest /mnt/bko-target
# the atimes the restore set, for boot to put back after its reads
sh -c 'mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before'

# ---- boot ----
# refuses to start unless /mnt/bko-target/etc/fstab is the restored system's (its / matches the layout's)
# / with the source's atime options (rw,relatime), for host-only dracut's rootflags=
mount -o remount,atime,relatime /mnt/bko-target
# the restored atimes (the restore stage lists them), to put back after this stage's reads
sh -c '[ -s /run/bko-holt/atimes.before ] || { mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before; }'
# the restored LVM devices file, kept
sh -c 'rm -rf /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices; [ ! -d /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices ] || { cp -a /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices && touch -r /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices.parent; }'
mount --rbind --make-rslave /dev /mnt/bko-target/dev
mount --rbind --make-rslave /proc /mnt/bko-target/proc
mount --rbind --make-rslave /sys /mnt/bko-target/sys
mount --rbind --make-rslave /run /mnt/bko-target/run
chroot /mnt/bko-target sh -c 'n=0; for k in /lib/modules/*; do [ -d "$k/kernel" ] || continue; l=$(lsinitrd -k "${k##*/}" 2>/dev/null); m=; for p in $(printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$l" | sed -n '\''s|^.* \(\(usr/\)*lib/modules/[^ ]*\.ko[.a-z0-9]*\)$|\1|p'\''); do [ -e "/$p" ] && b=${p##*/} && m="$m ${b%%.ko*}"; done; a=; f=; if printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$l" | sed -n '\''/^dracut modules:$/,/^=/p'\'' | grep -qx resume; then a=resume; r=$(lsinitrd -k "${k##*/}" -f etc/cmdline.d/95resume.conf 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$r" ] || { f=$(mktemp) && printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$r" > "$f"; } || exit; fi; dracut --force --kver "${k##*/}" ${m:+--add-drivers "$m"} ${a:+--add "$a"} ${f:+--include "$f" /etc/cmdline.d/95resume.conf}; s=$?; [ -z "$f" ] || rm -f "$f"; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || exit "$s"; n=$((n + 1)); done; [ "$n" -gt 0 ]'
# os-prober off: it would list the rescue system's disks
sh -c '[ ! -e /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/os-prober ] || mount --bind /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/true /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/os-prober'
chroot /mnt/bko-target env LANG=C grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg
sh -c '! grep -q '\'' /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/os-prober '\'' /proc/self/mountinfo || umount /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/os-prober'
# NVRAM's entries for this partition and loader, from an earlier restore here, deleted
bko-holt efi-dedupe /dev/sdq 2 '\EFI\fedora\shimx64.efi'
efibootmgr --quiet --create --disk /dev/sdq --part 2 --label Fedora --loader '\EFI\fedora\shimx64.efi'
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/var/log/bko-holt
# this restore's log, on the restored system
cp -a /run/bko-holt/log/. /mnt/bko-target/var/log/bko-holt/
# SELinux labels for the files the boot stage wrote
chroot /mnt/bko-target sh -c '[ -f /etc/selinux/config ] || exit 0; . /etc/selinux/config; [ "${SELINUX:-disabled}" != disabled ] || exit 0; f=/etc/selinux/${SELINUXTYPE:-targeted}/contexts/files/file_contexts; [ ! -f "$f" ] || ! command -v setfiles >/dev/null || { [ ! -d /etc/kernel ] || set -- /etc/kernel; setfiles "$f" /boot /var/log/bko-holt "$@"; }'
# SELinux labels for the mount points load made, which the mounts hide from the restore
chroot /mnt/bko-target sh -c '[ -f /etc/selinux/config ] || exit 0; . /etc/selinux/config; [ "${SELINUX:-disabled}" != disabled ] || exit 0; f=/etc/selinux/${SELINUXTYPE:-targeted}/contexts/files/file_contexts; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v setfiles >/dev/null || exit 0; r=/run/bko-holt/mount-points; mkdir -p "$r" && mount --bind / "$r" || exit 1; setfiles -r "$r" "$f" "$r"/boot "$r"/home; s=$?; umount "$r"; [ $s = 0 ] || exit $s; mkdir -p "$r"/boot && mount --bind /boot "$r"/boot || exit 1; setfiles -r "$r" "$f" "$r"/boot/efi; s=$?; umount "$r"/boot; [ $s = 0 ] || exit $s'
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target/run
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target/sys
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target/proc
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target/dev
# the restored LVM devices file, put back
sh -c '[ ! -d /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices ] || { rm -rf /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices && cp -a /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices && touch -r /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices.parent /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm; }'
# the atimes this stage's reads changed, put back
bash -c 'find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.after && LC_ALL=C comm -z -23 /run/bko-holt/atimes.before /run/bko-holt/atimes.after | \
             while IFS=$'\''\t'\'' read -r -d '\'''\'' a p; do [ -L "$p" ] || [ -e "$p" ] || continue; touch -a -h -d "@$a" -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || { [ ! -L "$p" ] && lsattr -d -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1 | grep -q i && { chattr -i -- "$p"; touch -a -h -d "@$a" -- "$p"; chattr +i -- "$p"; }; }; done'

# ---- close ----
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target
# other mount namespaces' copies of the target's mounts
sh -c 'me=$(readlink /proc/self/ns/mnt); seen=" $me "; at() { awk -v t=/mnt/bko-target '\''{ m = $5; if (m == t || length(m) > length(t) && substr(m, length(m) - length(t) + 1) == t) print m }'\''; }; for f in /proc/[0-9]*/mountinfo; do grep -q '\''/mnt/bko-target[ /]'\'' "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue; p=${f#/proc/}; p=${p%/mountinfo}; ns=$(readlink /proc/$p/ns/mnt) || continue; case $seen in *" $ns "*) continue;; esac; seen="$seen$ns "; echo "unmounting /mnt/bko-target in $ns (pid $p, $(cat /proc/$p/comm))"; for m in $(at <"$f"); do nsenter -t "$p" -m umount --recursive "$m" || true; done; done; awk '\''{ for (i = 7; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "-") { if ($(i + 1) == "nsfs" && $4 ~ /^mnt:\[/) print $4, $5; break } }'\'' /proc/self/mountinfo | while read -r ns b; do case $seen in *" $ns "*) continue;; esac; seen="$seen$ns "; ms=$(nsenter --mount="$b" cat /proc/self/mountinfo | at); [ -n "$ms" ] || continue; echo "unmounting /mnt/bko-target in $ns (bound at $b)"; for m in $ms; do nsenter --mount="$b" umount --recursive "$m" || true; done; done'
sh -c 'i=0; until udevadm settle; mdadm --stop /dev/md/boot; do i=$((i + 1)); [ $i -lt 5 ] || exit 1; sleep 1; done'
sh -c 'i=0; until udevadm settle; mdadm --stop /dev/md/label1; do i=$((i + 1)); [ $i -lt 5 ] || exit 1; sleep 1; done'

bko-holt md-lbs /dev/sdq2 629137408 512
# vdb2: the md superblock as the source's kernel reads it
bko-holt md-lbs /dev/sdr2 629137408 512
# vda1: the md superblock as the source's kernel reads it
bko-holt md-lbs /dev/sdq1 4096 512
# vdb1: the md superblock as the source's kernel reads it
bko-holt md-lbs /dev/sdr1 4096 512
